verification_description: Flood insurance premium - if not found, this is not a flood insurance policy

flood_insurance_premium.description: Annual flood insurance premium (REQUIRED for verification)

replacement_cost_of_improvements.description: Replacement cost of the insured improvements, used for the 'lesser of 3' flood coverage rule (RM Job Aid p.13, J-T6)

in_sfha.description: Whether the property is in a Special Flood Hazard Area (SFHA) per the flood zone determination. Found in LG-docsOrch's production Flood Certificate/Insurance extraction schema but never modeled here; lets flood-insurance-required-or-not be derived from the document itself instead of needing an externally-supplied loan_context['is_flood_zone'] flag.
